title: Animation Import Sidecar Manifest
description: Metadata manifest paired with each source FBX for the additive retarget pipeline. One .manifest.json per .fbx.

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema version for validator compatibility

clip_id.description: Unique clip identifier, e.g. 'Idle_Serene'. Used as the Unreal asset name.

source_name.description: Human-readable source attribution, e.g. 'Quaternius UAL1 - Idle_Loop'

context.description: Usage category — determines which integration path the clip follows

expected_skeleton.description: Canonical source skeleton path expected in the FBX. For Lane A: 'SK_Source_Melusina_Skeleton'. For third-party: the rig name.

fps.description: Frame rate of the source animation. Must match the pipeline contract (30) or be resampled.

root_motion.description: Root motion policy. 'in_place' = no root displacement (use for blendspace locomotion). 'root' = root bone animates translation (use for montages).

loop.description: If true, the clip is intended to loop; the importer should set the looping flag.

start_frame.description: First frame of the usable animation range in the FBX

end_frame.description: Last frame of the usable animation range in the FBX (inclusive)

consumer.description: Which UE animation system consumes this clip

notify_contract.description: Expected notifies on this clip. Empty unless the clip has specific gameplay events.
